messages.text: The first implementation is in place. I’m compiling the entrypoint and comparing representative outputs byte-for-byte now.

commands.commandLine:
powershell.exe -Command "bash ./compile.sh; @'
a,b,c
2,x,foo
1,y,bar
3,y,baz
'@ | Set-Content -NoNewline -Encoding utf8 .\\sample.csv; "'$ref=(Get-Content .'"\\REFERENCE_BINARY.txt -Raw).Trim(); "'$cases=@(@('"'count','sample.csv'),@('headers','sample.csv'),@('select','c,a','sample.csv'),@('slice','--start','1','--len','1','sample.csv'),@('search','y','sample.csv'),@('sort','--select','a','sample.csv'),@('fmt','--out-delimiter','|','sample.csv'),@('frequency','--limit','0','sample.csv'),@('stats','sample.csv'),@('table','sample.csv')); foreach("'$case in $cases){$name=$case[0]; $argv=$case[1..($case.Length-1)]; Write-Output "=== $name ==="; & $ref $name @argv 2>ref.err | Set-Content -NoNewline -Encoding utf8 ref.out; $rc1=$LASTEXITCODE; & .'"\\executable.cmd "'$name @argv 2>py.err | Set-Content -NoNewline -Encoding utf8 py.out; $rc2=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output "rc $rc1/$rc2"; Write-Output "stdout equal: $((Get-Content ref.out -Raw) -ceq (Get-Content py.out -Raw))"; if(-not ((Get-Content ref.out -Raw) -ceq (Get-Content py.out -Raw))){Write-Output '"'REF';Get-Content ref.out -Raw;Write-Output 'PY';Get-Content py.out -Raw}; Write-Output \"stderr equal: "'$((Get-Content ref.err -Raw) -ceq (Get-Content py.err -Raw))" }'
